```{r}
# Build file paths
model_files <- here::here("Models", paste0("Decision Tree ", params$version, " ", params$target_classes, " model.rds"))

# Read each model into a named list
model_list <- setNames(
  lapply(model_files, readRDS),
  params$target_classes
)

# Build file paths
data_files <- here::here("Data", paste0("Decision Tree ", params$version, " ", params$target_classes, " Data.rds"))

# Read each model into a named list
data_list <- setNames(
  lapply(data_files, readRDS),
  params$target_classes
)
```

```{r}

## PREDICTIONS ##

thePredictions <- lapply(params$target_classes, function(x) {
  
  # identify course values in testing that aren't in training
  
  courseColumn <- ifelse("course" %in% colnames(data_list[[x]][["testing"]]), "course", "FIRST_MATH_COURSE_CATNBR")
  
  missing <- setdiff(data_list[[x]][["testing"]][[courseColumn]],data_list[[x]][["training"]][[courseColumn]])
  
  if (length(missing) == 0) {
  # no missing values — keep everything
  missingFilter <- rep(TRUE, nrow(data_list[[x]][["testing"]]))
} else {
  # normal case — exclude the missing courses
  missingFilter <- !data_list[[x]][["testing"]][[courseColumn]] %in% missing
  
  # print(x)
  # print(table(missingFilter))
}
  
  # drop 2025
  remove2025 <- data_list[[x]][["testing"]][["class_year"]] != 2025
  
  predict(model_list[[x]],
          newdata = data_list[[x]][["testing"]][missingFilter & remove2025,])
  
} )
names(thePredictions) <- params$target_classes

```

```{r}

# normalized errors

normalized_metrics <- function(pred, obs) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2))
  mae  <- mean(abs(pred - obs))
  r2   <- cor(pred, obs)^2
  
  range_y <- diff(range(obs, na.rm = TRUE))
  sd_y    <- sd(obs, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    RMSE = rmse,
    MAE  = mae,
    R2   = r2,
    NRMSE_range = rmse / range_y,
    NMAE_range  = mae  / range_y,
    NRMSE_sd    = rmse / sd_y,
    NMAE_sd     = mae  / sd_y
  )
}  
  
normResults <- lapply(params$target_classes, function(x) {
  
  # identify course values in testing that aren't in training
  
    courseColumn <- ifelse("course" %in% colnames(data_list[[x]][["testing"]]), "course", "FIRST_MATH_COURSE_CATNBR")
  
  missing <- setdiff(data_list[[x]][["testing"]][[courseColumn]],data_list[[x]][["training"]][[courseColumn]])
  
  if (length(missing) == 0) {
  # no missing values — keep everything
  missingFilter <- rep(TRUE, nrow(data_list[[x]][["testing"]]))
} else {
  # normal case — exclude the missing courses
  missingFilter <- !data_list[[x]][["testing"]][[courseColumn]] %in% missing
  
#  print(x)
#  print(table(missingFilter))
}
  
      # remove 2025
  remove2025 <- data_list[[x]][["testing"]][["class_year"]] != 2025
  
  normalized_metrics(
    pred = thePredictions[[x]],
    obs = data_list[[x]][["testing"]][[x]][missingFilter & remove2025]
  )
  
})  
names(normResults) <- params$target_classes
```

```{r}
library(kableExtra)

normResults |>
  (\(x){do.call(rbind,x)})() |>
  (\(x){round(x,2)})()|>
    kbl(
    caption = "Normalized Regression Results Across Grading Buckets",
    align = "c",
    col.names = c("",
      "RMSE", "MAE", "R-sq", 
      "NRMSE (Range)", "NMAE (Range)", 
      "NRMSE (SD)", "NMAE (SD)"
    )
  ) |>
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Calibri") |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f0f0") |>  # header
  row_spec(1:length(params$target_classes), background = c("#ffffff", "#f9f9f9")) |> # alternating rows
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Raw Metrics" = 3, "Normalized Metrics" = 4))
```
